instructions: BAN exposes public geocoding and reverse-geocoding endpoints without credentials.
CmsCore creates the source contract and response fields used by bindings.
Bindings can target search and reverse geocoding by their endpoint ids.
checks: No secret is required for the public BAN API.
The source contract is validated before import.
Existing sources require force when re-importing.
resources: BAN address search and reverse-geocoding contracts
GeoJSON response fields for address bindings
review: Search resolves French addresses to GeoJSON features.
Reverse geocoding resolves coordinates to an address.
The source is public and does not store credentials.
syncNote: The import installs the public BAN source contract without writing secrets.
